emptyText: Add game files (ROMs); NostaljiBox recognizes the console and opens the right emulator. ZIP files work too.
demoNote: Two free, open-licensed (MIT) homebrew games: Stalactites and Waternet.
disclaimer: NostaljiBox contains no games; only use backups of games you own. The systems named are trademarks of their owners; NostaljiBox is not affiliated with them.
unknownFile: I couldn't recognize the console for “{file}”. Pick one:
licensesText: The game screen and the emulator cores are distributed under open-source licenses; their source code is at the links below.
playerSource: Source code of the game screen (GPL-3.0): {url}
answerLinkHere: Open this reply link on the phone running the game, while its 👥 screen is open.
gameNotFound: Game not found. Go back to the library and add it again.
hostStep1: 1. On the second phone open NostaljiBox → Join as player 2 and scan this code, or send the invite in a message:
hostStep2: 2. Scan the code the second phone shows here, or tap the reply link you receive:
stillLoading: The game is still loading, try again in a moment.
hostNoCamera: Couldn't open the camera; you can exchange the codes with copy and paste.
p2Connected: Player 2 connected, sending them the game…
connectFailed: Couldn't connect. Are both phones on the same Wi-Fi?
hostScanHint: Scan this code with the second phone, then show its code to this camera.
noLinkCode: No connection code on the clipboard
thisIsInvite: This is a join invite; create an invite with 👥 on the host phone.
joinHint: On the host phone (same Wi-Fi), open the game and tap 👥.
guestStep1: 1. Scan the code on the host phone, or tap the invite link you received:
guestStep2: 2. Show this code to the host phone, or send the reply back in a message:
receivingGame: Connected, receiving the game from the host phone…
hostLeft: Lost the connection to the host phone
showReplyHint: Now show this code to the host phone's camera, or send the reply back in a message.
noInviteCode: No invite code on the clipboard
thisIsReply: This is a reply code; open it on the host phone.
guestNoCamera: Couldn't open the camera; copy the code from the host phone and paste it below.
oldVersion: NostaljiBox on the other phone is an older version; update both phones.
notACode: This is not a NostaljiBox connection code.
